diagnosis: Redeems a single-use download ticket from Redis to serve a file. The endpoint does not check if the ticket payload's issued_to_user_id matches current_user.id, allowing any user holding a guessed or intercepted ticket string to download another user's file.
exploit_request:
GET /api/downloads/redeem?ticket=tkt_7b049d1e HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
